result.rationale: In parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts the schema uses computed keys `[z.string().toString()]: z.number()` — z.string() is a ZodString object whose .toString() is '[object Object]', so both computed keys collapse to the same literal key and the real fields (e.g. expiry_date, refresh_token) are stripped by Zod's default stripping. Then `if (!refreshTokenResponse.data.refresh_token) { refreshTokenResponse.data.refresh_token = "refresh_token" }` substitutes a fabricated token, which is then persisted via `prisma.credential.update` in the callers (Google, Office365, Zoom).
